## 13. Packs and rules: `safety`

### safety

Protects secrets, git history and the machine from destructive commands.

User level; not detected: `forge apply --user` installs it.

| Rule | Description | Scope | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `safety/cdk-destructive` | cdk deploy --require-approval never (deploys IAM and security changes unreviewed) and cdk destroy (deletes stacks) need confirmation. | any | guard ask: command `{name: cdk, sub: [deploy], flags_any: [--require-approval=never], value_flags: [--require-approval]}` or `{name: cdk, sub: [destroy]}` |
| `safety/chmod-777` | No world-writable permissions (chmod 777, 0777, a+rwx, ugo+rwx, =rwx) and no recursive chown of /, ~ or $HOME: give the one user or group that needs it access instead. | any | guard deny: command `{name: chmod, args_any: [777, 0777, a+rwx, ugo+rwx, =rwx]}` or `{name: chown, args_any: [/, ~, ~/, $HOME, $HOME/, '${HOME}', '${HOME}/'], flags_any: [-R, --recursive]}` |
| `safety/cloud-destructive` | Claude asks before a cloud CLI deletes resources: aws delete-*, terminate-instances, deregister-*, s3 rb and s3 rm --recursive; gcloud, az and doctl delete; gsutil rm and rb; fly apps / volumes / postgres / machines destroy or delete; railway down and delete; vercel remove; heroku apps:destroy; netlify sites:delete; wrangler … delete. One command can delete production. | any | guard ask: command `{name: aws, sub: ['*', delete-*\|terminate-instances\|deregister-*\|rb]}` or `{name: aws, sub: [s3, rm], flags_any: [--recursive]}` or `{name: [gcloud, az, doctl], args_any: [delete]}` or `{name: gsutil, sub: [rm\|rb]}` or `{name: [fly, flyctl], sub: [apps\|volume\|volumes\|postgres\|machine\|machines, destroy\|delete\|remove\|rm]}` or `{name: railway, sub: [down\|delete]}` or `{name: railway, sub: [volume, delete]}` or `{name: vercel, sub: [remove\|rm]}` or `{name: heroku, sub: ['apps:destroy']}` or `{name: netlify, sub: ['sites:delete']}` or `{name: wrangler, sub: ['*'], args_any: [delete]}` |
| `safety/datastore-reset` | Claude asks before wiping a local datastore (redis-cli FLUSHALL or FLUSHDB, supabase db reset, manage.py flush); the database it reaches may not be a disposable one. | any | guard ask: command `{name: redis-cli, arg_regex: (?im)^\s*flush(all\|db)\b, stdin: true}` or `{name: supabase, sub: [db, reset]}` or `{name: manage.py, sub: [flush]}` |
| `safety/docker-privileged` | Containers started by Claude never get the host (--privileged, host pid/ipc/userns, ALL or SYS_ADMIN capabilities, unconfined seccomp or AppArmor, the Docker socket, or a mount of /, /etc, /root or the home directory); docker runs outside Claude Code's sandbox. | any | guard deny: command `{name: [docker, podman], sub: [run\|create\|exec], flags_any: [--privileged, --pid=host, --ipc=host, --userns=host, --cap-add=ALL, --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN, --security-opt=seccomp=unconfined, '--security-opt=seccomp:unconfined', --security-opt=apparmor=unconfined, '--security-opt=apparmor:unconfined'], value_flags: [--pid, --ipc, --userns, --cap-add, --security-opt, -v, --volume, --mount, -e, --env, --name, -p, --publish, -w, --workdir, -u, --user, --network, --entrypoint]}` or `{name: [docker, podman], sub: [container, run\|create\|exec], flags_any: [--privileged, --pid=host, --ipc=host, --userns=host, --cap-add=ALL, --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN, --security-opt=seccomp=unconfined, '--security-opt=seccomp:unconfined', --security-opt=apparmor=unconfined, '--security-opt=apparmor:unconfined'], value_flags: [--pid, --ipc, --userns, --cap-add, --security-opt, -v, --volume, --mount, -e, --env, --name, -p, --publish, -w, --workdir, -u, --user, --network, --entrypoint]}` or `{name: [docker, podman], sub: [run\|create\|exec\|container], arg_regex: docker\.sock}` or `{name: [docker, podman], sub: [run\|create\|container], value_flags: [-e, --env, --name, -p, --publish, -w, --workdir, -u, --user, --network, --entrypoint], option_values: {--mount: '(^\|,)(source\|src)=(/\|/etc\|/root\|~\|\$HOME\|\$\{HOME\})/?(,\|$)', -v\|--volume: '^(/\|/etc\|/root\|~\|\$HOME\|\$\{HOME\})/?(:\|$)'}}` |
| `safety/docker-push` | Claude asks before pushing an image to a registry (docker push, docker image push, docker compose push, buildx --push). | any | guard ask: command `{name: [docker, podman], sub: [push]}` or `{name: [docker, podman], sub: [image, push]}` or `{name: [docker, podman], sub: [buildx], flags_any: [--push]}` or `{name: [docker, podman], sub: [compose], args_any: [push]}` or `{name: docker-compose, sub: [push]}` |
| `safety/docker-volumes` | Docker volumes are never deleted by Claude (docker compose down -v, docker volume rm/prune, system prune --volumes); they hold databases. | any | guard deny: command `{name: docker, sub: [compose], args_any: [down], flags_any: [-v, --volumes]}` or `{name: docker-compose, sub: [down], flags_any: [-v, --volumes]}` or `{name: docker, sub: [volume, rm\|prune]}` or `{name: docker, sub: [system, prune], flags_any: [--volumes]}` |
| `safety/dropdb` | Databases are never dropped by Claude. | any | permission deny `Bash(dropdb:*)` |
| `safety/ephemeral-exec` | Claude asks before running a package fetched from a registry on the fly (pnpm dlx, pipx run, a launcher given --package or name@version, npx / bunx / uvx on a command not installed in the project, deno run npm:…, and create / init forms whose create-<name> initializer is not installed); a typo or a hijacked name runs someone else's code. Tools installed in the project (npx tsc, bunx prisma) run as usual. | any | guard ask: check `ephemeral-exec` |
| `safety/git-branch-force-delete` | Force-deleting a branch needs confirmation; unmerged commits on it are lost. | any | guard ask: command `{name: git, sub: [branch], flags_any: [-D]}` or `{name: git, sub: [branch], flags_all: [-d\|--delete, -f\|--force]}` |
| `safety/git-clean` | git clean deletes untracked files. | any | permission deny `Bash(git clean:*)` |
| `safety/git-discard` | Discarding working-tree changes (git checkout -- / git checkout . / git restore) loses work. | any | guard deny: command `{name: git, sub: [checkout], args_any: [.]}` or `{name: git, sub: [checkout], arg_regex: ^--$}` or `{name: git, sub: [restore], flags_none: [--staged, -S]}` or `{name: git, sub: [restore], flags_any: [--worktree, -W]}` |
| `safety/git-force-push` | Force-pushing overwrites remote history. Use --force-with-lease if you must. | any | guard deny: command `{name: git, sub: [push], flags_any: [--force, -f]}` or `{name: git, sub: [push], args_any: [+*]}` |
| `safety/git-force-with-lease` | git push --force-with-lease still rewrites remote history; confirm it. | any | guard ask: command `{name: git, sub: [push], flags_any: [--force-with-lease]}` |
| `safety/git-history-rewrite` | History rewriting and reflog destruction are not done by Claude. | any | permission deny `Bash(git filter-branch:*)`<br>permission deny `Bash(git filter-repo:*)`<br>permission deny `Bash(git reflog expire:*)`<br>permission deny `Bash(git stash clear:*)` |
| `safety/git-no-verify` | Commit hooks are never bypassed: no git commit --no-verify or -n, no SKIP=, PRE_COMMIT_ALLOW_NO_CONFIG=, HUSKY=, HUSKY_SKIP_HOOKS=, LEFTHOOK= or LEFTHOOK_EXCLUDE= assignment, no git -c core.hooksPath=…, no setting or unsetting core.hooksPath, no pre-commit or lefthook uninstall, and no rm, mv, chmod or truncate on .git/hooks/ or .husky/ (the project's checks run from those hooks). Reading core.hooksPath is fine. | any | guard deny: command `{name: git, sub: [commit], flags_any: [--no-verify, -n], value_flags: [-m, --message, -F, --file, -C, -c, --reuse-message, --reedit-message, --author, --date, --fixup, --squash, --trailer, --cleanup, -t, --template]}` or `{env_any: [SKIP, PRE_COMMIT_ALLOW_NO_CONFIG, HUSKY, HUSKY_SKIP_HOOKS, LEFTHOOK, LEFTHOOK_EXCLUDE]}` or `{name: git, option_values: {-c: '^core\.hooks[Pp]ath='}}` or `{name: git, sub: [config, core.hooksPath\|core.hookspath], args_any: ['*']}` or `{name: git, sub: [config, set\|unset, core.hooksPath\|core.hookspath]}` or `{name: git, sub: [config, core.hooksPath\|core.hookspath], flags_any: [--unset, --unset-all]}` or `{name: [pre-commit, lefthook], sub: [uninstall]}` or `{name: [rm, mv, chmod, truncate], arg_regex: (^\|/)(\.git/hooks\|\.husky)(/\|$)}` |
| `safety/git-reset-hard` | git reset --hard discards uncommitted work. | any | permission deny `Bash(git reset --hard:*)` |
| `safety/git-stash-drop` | Dropping a stash needs confirmation; it deletes work that no branch references. | any | guard ask: command `{name: git, sub: [stash, drop]}` |
| `safety/kubernetes-change` | Claude asks before changing a cluster outside the manifests (kubectl delete, drain, edit, patch, replace, scale to 0 replicas, helm uninstall or rollback); the current kube context may be production. | any | guard ask: command `{name: kubectl, sub: [delete\|drain\|edit\|patch\|replace]}` or `{name: kubectl, sub: [scale], flags_any: [--replicas=0], value_flags: [--replicas]}` or `{name: helm, sub: [uninstall\|delete\|del\|un\|rollback]}` |
| `safety/kubernetes-destructive` | No kubectl delete of namespaces, persistent volumes or their claims, or custom resource definitions, and none with --all, -A or --all-namespaces: the current kube context may be production, and the data goes with them. | any | guard deny: command `{name: kubectl, sub: [delete, '/^(ns\|namespaces?\|pv\|pvc\|persistentvolumes?\|persistentvolumeclaims?\|crds?\|customresourcedefinitions?)([/.,]\|$)/']}` or `{name: kubectl, sub: [delete], flags_any: [--all, -A, --all-namespaces]}` |
| `safety/lockfile-bash-write` | Rewriting a lock file through Bash asks first: sed -i / perl -i (perl -0pi included), a redirect or tee into one, cp, mv, install or rsync onto one, dd of=, truncate, or a Python, Node, Bun, Deno or Ruby command that names one and writes. Reading one does not ask, unless such a script also writes something. Change the manifest and run the package manager (bun install, pnpm install, uv lock, cargo update -p …) instead. | any | guard ask: command `{name: [sed, perl], flags_any: [-i, --in-place], value_flags: [-e, --expression, -f, --file], arg_regex: (^\|/)(pnpm-lock\.yaml\|package-lock\.json\|npm-shrinkwrap\.json\|yarn\.lock\|bun\.lockb?\|uv\.lock\|poetry\.lock\|Cargo\.lock\|deno\.lock\|pdm\.lock\|pixi\.lock\|Pipfile\.lock\|\.terraform\.lock\.hcl\|flake\.lock\|mise\.lock\|go\.sum\|Gemfile\.lock\|composer\.lock\|packages\.lock\.json)$}` or `{redirect_to: (^\|/)(pnpm-lock\.yaml\|package-lock\.json\|npm-shrinkwrap\.json\|yarn\.lock\|bun\.lockb?\|uv\.lock\|poetry\.lock\|Cargo\.lock\|deno\.lock\|pdm\.lock\|pixi\.lock\|Pipfile\.lock\|\.terraform\.lock\.hcl\|flake\.lock\|mise\.lock\|go\.sum\|Gemfile\.lock\|composer\.lock\|packages\.lock\.json)$}` or `{name: [tee, truncate], args_any: [/(^\|/)(pnpm-lock\.yaml\|package-lock\.json\|npm-shrinkwrap\.json\|yarn\.lock\|bun\.lockb?\|uv\.lock\|poetry\.lock\|Cargo\.lock\|deno\.lock\|pdm\.lock\|pixi\.lock\|Pipfile\.lock\|\.terraform\.lock\.hcl\|flake\.lock\|mise\.lock\|go\.sum\|Gemfile\.lock\|composer\.lock\|packages\.lock\.json)$/]}` or `{name: [cp, mv, install, rsync], last_arg: (^\|/)(pnpm-lock\.yaml\|package-lock\.json\|npm-shrinkwrap\.json\|yarn\.lock\|bun\.lockb?\|uv\.lock\|poetry\.lock\|Cargo\.lock\|deno\.lock\|pdm\.lock\|pixi\.lock\|Pipfile\.lock\|\.terraform\.lock\.hcl\|flake\.lock\|mise\.lock\|go\.sum\|Gemfile\.lock\|composer\.lock\|packages\.lock\.json)$}` or `{name: dd, arg_regex: ^of=(.*/)?(pnpm-lock\.yaml\|package-lock\.json\|npm-shrinkwrap\.json\|yarn\.lock\|bun\.lockb?\|uv\.lock\|poetry\.lock\|Cargo\.lock\|deno\.lock\|pdm\.lock\|pixi\.lock\|Pipfile\.lock\|\.terraform\.lock\.hcl\|flake\.lock\|mise\.lock\|go\.sum\|Gemfile\.lock\|composer\.lock\|packages\.lock\.json)$}` or `{name: [python*, pypy*, node, bun, deno, ruby], arg_regex: '(pnpm-lock\.yaml\|package-lock\.json\|npm-shrinkwrap\.json\|yarn\.lock\|bun\.lockb?\|uv\.lock\|poetry\.lock\|Cargo\.lock\|deno\.lock\|pdm\.lock\|pixi\.lock\|Pipfile\.lock\|\.terraform\.lock\.hcl\|flake\.lock\|mise\.lock\|go\.sum\|Gemfile\.lock\|composer\.lock\|packages\.lock\.json).*(\.write\(\|write_text\|writeFile\|Bun\.write\|[(,]\s*["'']w[+b]?["''])\|(\.write\(\|write_text\|writeFile\|Bun\.write\|[(,]\s*["'']w[+b]?["'']).*(pnpm-lock\.yaml\|package-lock\.json\|npm-shrinkwrap\.json\|yarn\.lock\|bun\.lockb?\|uv\.lock\|poetry\.lock\|Cargo\.lock\|deno\.lock\|pdm\.lock\|pixi\.lock\|Pipfile\.lock\|\.terraform\.lock\.hcl\|flake\.lock\|mise\.lock\|go\.sum\|Gemfile\.lock\|composer\.lock\|packages\.lock\.json)', stdin: true}` |
| `safety/lockfile-hand-edit` | Lock files are not edited by hand: an Edit or Write of pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, yarn.lock, bun.lock, deno.lock, uv.lock, poetry.lock, pdm.lock, pixi.lock, Pipfile.lock, Cargo.lock, go.sum, Gemfile.lock, composer.lock, packages.lock.json, flake.lock, mise.lock or .terraform.lock.hcl needs confirmation. Change the manifest and run the package manager (bun install, pnpm install, uv lock, cargo update -p …) instead. | any | permission ask `Edit(**/pnpm-lock.yaml)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/package-lock.json)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/npm-shrinkwrap.json)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/yarn.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/bun.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/uv.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/poetry.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/Cargo.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/deno.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/pdm.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/pixi.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/Pipfile.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/.terraform.lock.hcl)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/flake.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/mise.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/go.sum)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/Gemfile.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/composer.lock)`<br>permission ask `Edit(**/packages.lock.json)` |
| `safety/no-break-system-packages` | Packages are never installed into the system: no --break-system-packages or PIP_BREAK_SYSTEM_PACKAGES (they bypass the PEP 668 protection of the OS's Python), and no sudo pip / npm / pnpm / yarn / bun install, which runs install scripts as root. Use a virtual environment or the project's package manager. | any | guard deny: command `{name: [pip, pip3, pip3.*, uv, pipx], flags_any: [--break-system-packages]}` or `{env_any: [PIP_BREAK_SYSTEM_PACKAGES]}` or `{name: [pip, pip3, pip3.*], sub: [install], wrapped_by: [sudo, doas]}` or `{name: [npm, pnpm, yarn, bun], sub: [i\|install\|add\|global], wrapped_by: [sudo, doas]}` |
| `safety/no-vendored-edits` | Installed packages are not edited: Edit and Write under node_modules/, .venv/ or site-packages/ are denied. An edit there vanishes on the next install and hides the real fix; patch through the package manager (patch-package, pnpm patch, bun patch) or upgrade the dependency instead. | any | permission deny `Edit(**/node_modules/**)`<br>permission deny `Edit(**/.venv/**)`<br>permission deny `Edit(**/site-packages/**)` |
| `safety/package-add` | Adding a named package through any package manager needs confirmation (npm, pnpm, yarn and bun install / i / add, yarn and pnpm global add, pip and uv pip install, python -m pip install, uv add, poetry add, pdm add, pipenv install, pipx install, uv tool install); models invent package names that attackers then register (slopsquatting). Installs from the lock file or a requirements file, and local installs (-e, .), do not ask. | any | guard ask: check `package-add` |
| `safety/prisma-ai-consent` | Claude never sets PRISMA_USER_CONSENT_FOR_DANGEROUS_AI_ACTION, the variable through which only the user consents to a destructive Prisma command. | any | guard deny: command `{env_any: [PRISMA_USER_CONSENT_FOR_DANGEROUS_AI_ACTION]}` |
| `safety/publish` | Packages are published by a human, not by Claude. | any | permission deny `Bash(npm publish:*)`<br>permission deny `Bash(bun publish:*)`<br>permission deny `Bash(uv publish:*)` |
| `safety/pulumi-destructive` | Unpreviewed or destructive Pulumi commands need confirmation - pulumi up / refresh with --yes, -y or --skip-preview, pulumi destroy, stack rm, state delete / unprotect, cancel. | any | guard ask: command `{name: pulumi, sub: [destroy\|cancel]}` or `{name: pulumi, sub: [stack, rm]}` or `{name: pulumi, sub: [state, delete\|unprotect]}` or `{name: pulumi, sub: [up\|refresh], flags_any: [--yes, -y, --skip-preview]}` |
| `safety/remote-script` | Remote scripts are never piped into an interpreter. | any | guard deny: command `{name: [curl, wget], pipe_to: [sh, bash, zsh, dash, ksh, python*, bun, node]}` or `{name: base64, flags_any: [-d, -D, --decode], pipe_to: [sh, bash, zsh, dash, ksh]}` or `{name: [sh, bash, zsh, dash, ksh], arg_regex: ^(<\(\|\$\()\s*(curl\|wget)\s}` |
| `safety/rm-root` | No recursive rm on /, ~, $HOME or the parent directory, nor on a bare variable followed by / or /* ($DIR/, ${OUT}/*), which is / when the variable is empty; ${VAR:?}/ fails instead and is fine. | any | guard deny: command `{name: rm, args_any: ['/^(/\|~\|\$HOME\|\$\{HOME\}\|\.\.)/?\*?$/'], flags_any: [-r, -R, --recursive]}` or `{name: rm, args_any: ['/^\$\{?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\}?/\*?$/'], flags_any: [-r, -R, --recursive]}` |
| `safety/sandbox` | Bash runs in the sandbox with network limited to package registries and GitHub. | any | sandbox `enabled` = `true`<br>sandbox `network.allowedDomains` = `["registry.npmjs.org","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","github.com"]` |
| `safety/secret-files` | Secret files are never read or edited by Claude. | any | permission deny `Read(**/.env)`<br>permission deny `Read(**/.env.local)`<br>permission deny `Read(**/.env.development)`<br>permission deny `Read(**/.env.production)`<br>permission deny `Read(**/.env.test)`<br>permission deny `Edit(**/.env)`<br>permission deny `Edit(**/.env.local)`<br>permission deny `Edit(**/.env.development)`<br>permission deny `Edit(**/.env.production)`<br>permission deny `Edit(**/.env.test)`<br>permission deny `Read(**/*.pem)`<br>permission deny `Read(**/*.key)`<br>permission deny `Read(~/.ssh/**)`<br>permission deny `Read(~/.netrc)`<br>permission deny `Read(~/.npmrc)`<br>permission deny `Read(~/.pypirc)`<br>permission deny `Read(~/.pgpass)`<br>permission deny `Read(~/.git-credentials)`<br>permission deny `Read(~/.config/gh/hosts.yml)`<br>permission deny `Read(~/.docker/config.json)` |
| `safety/secret-read-bash` | Secret files are not read or copied through Bash. | any | guard deny: command `{name: [cat, less, more, head, tail, cp, source, ., grep, base64], arg_regex: '(^\|[/=])\.env(\.(local\|development\|production\|test\|staging\|dev\|prod))?$'}` or `{name: [cat, less, more, head, tail, cp, source, ., grep, base64], arg_regex: '^(~\|\$HOME\|\$\{HOME\})/(\.ssh/\|\.pgpass\|\.netrc)'}` |
| `safety/sql-destructive` | No data-destroying database commands: DROP TABLE / DATABASE / SCHEMA, TRUNCATE or a DELETE FROM without WHERE through psql, mysql, mariadb or sqlite3; dropDatabase() or .drop() through mongosh or mongo; heroku pg:reset; supabase db reset on a linked or remote database. | any | guard deny: command `{name: [psql, mysql, mariadb, sqlite3], arg_regex: '(?i)(\bdrop\s+(table\|database\|schema)(\s\|;\|$)\|\btruncate(\s\|;\|$)\|\bdelete\s+from\s+[a-z0-9_."]+\s*(;\|$))', stdin: true}` or `{name: [mongosh, mongo], arg_regex: (dropDatabase\|\.drop)\s*\(, stdin: true}` or `{name: heroku, sub: ['pg:reset']}` or `{name: supabase, sub: [db, reset], flags_any: [--linked, --db-url]}` |
| `safety/terraform-destroy` | terraform / tofu destroy, unattended applies, state surgery (state rm, mv, push, replace-provider, force-unlock, CLI import, workspace delete) and applies with -replace=, -target= or -lock=false need confirmation: they change real infrastructure outside the plan the user saw. Declarative moved, removed and import blocks go through the plan. | any | guard ask: command `{name: [terraform, tofu], sub: [destroy]}` or `{name: [terraform, tofu], sub: [apply], flags_any: [-auto-approve, --auto-approve, -replace, -target, -lock=false]}` or `{name: [terraform, tofu], sub: [state, rm\|mv\|push\|replace-provider]}` or `{name: [terraform, tofu], sub: [force-unlock\|import]}` or `{name: [terraform, tofu], sub: [workspace, delete]}` |
